candidates.title: [P1][711] Bound real Station child settlement without unsafe PID signaling
candidates.excerpt: ## Problem The real Station E2E process helper can wait forever after its command timeout: it sends one `SIGTERM` through Node's `ChildProcess.kill()` and then awaits `close` without a bound. That can prevent later cleanup and endpoint proof from running. A proposed #711 fix added delayed `SIGTERM`/`SIGKILL` escalation based on `ChildProcess` object/PID equality. Node explicitly does not make that exact physical-process-generation authority: a delayed signal may target a reassigned PID, and post-spawn `error` does not prove child settlement. This is a separable real-test process-lifecycle responsibility and must not be smuggled into tmux fixt
candidates.boundary: Public issue report. It can support a concrete case, not market-wide demand without corroboration.
